crew.overview: In a hospital on the outskirts of 1920s Los Angeles, an injured stuntman begins to tell a fellow patient, a little girl with a broken arm, a fantastic story about 5 mythical heroes. Thanks to his fractured state of mind and her vivid imagination, the line between fiction and reality starts to blur as the tale advances.
crew.title: The Fall

crew.overview: A US Fighter pilot's epic struggle of survival after being shot down on a mission over Laos during the Vietnam War.
crew.title: Rescue Dawn

details.biography:
Originally from the UK, Adam moved to SE Asia after 16 years working in the UK special effects industry. He has lived in Thailand and Indonesia but moved to Malaysia in 2013 when the new Pinewood studios opened in Johor Bahru with 'Marco Polo'. He lives in Johor with his Malaysian wife, Kimberley.

Adam speaks Malay, Indonesian, and a fair amount of Thai. Adam is a member of the Institute of Explosives Engineers and is an expert pyrotechnician. In his spare time, he is a keen SCUBA diver and enjoys exploring the warm, clear seas of the region.
details.name: Adam Howarth
